definitions.gloss: total destruction by fire; burned to the ground
definitions.explanation: A building or structure being completely destroyed by fire, with nothing salvageable remaining.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全焼|ぜんしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The house burned to the ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全焼|ぜんしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The shop was completely destroyed in the fire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧3{棟|むね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全焼|ぜんしょう}し、2{人|にん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{負傷|ふしょう}した→負傷する：28056_fushousuru⟧。
examples.english: Three houses were completely destroyed and two people were injured in the late-night fire.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily used in news reporting and official fire department records. Often paired with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {全焼|ぜんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The degree of fire damage is categorized officially in Japan as {全焼|ぜんしょう} (total), ⟦{半焼|はんしょう}→半焼：24445_hanshou⟧ (partial), or {部分焼|ぶぶんしょう} (minor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全焼|ぜんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be completely destroyed by fire)
- ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全焼|ぜんしょう} (house totally burned)
- {全焼|ぜんしょう}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (total fire damage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{半焼|はんしょう}→半焼：24445_hanshou⟧: partially burned — partial fire damage
- ⟦{焼失|しょうしつ}→焼失：13480_shoushitsu⟧: destruction by fire — more formal/literary equivalent
- ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧: fire (incident) — the event itself, not the result
